{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Under the current Administration, the civil service has grown by at least 140,000 workers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The number of federal workers making at least $150,000 has doubled under the current Administration.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The national debt has increased to over $15.9 trillion under the current Administration.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The growth of the civil service and the increase in the national debt under the current Administration are grossly irresponsible.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for a reduction in the federal payroll of at least 10 percent through attrition.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for adjusting pay scales and benefits to reflect those of the private sector.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for bringing the 130-year old Civil Service System into the twenty-first century.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for a federal pay system that is sufficiently flexible to acknowledge and reward innovation, overhead reduction, process optimization, and expedited paperwork.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Delinquency in paying taxes and repaying student loans has been too common in some segments of the civil service.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A Republican Administration will prioritize enforcement of tax and student loan obligations among its own employees.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A Republican Administration will not name to public office anyone who has failed to meet their financial obligations to the government and fellow taxpayers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
